facts.fact: Fawry, an Egyptian listed private fintech, raised its stake in software provider Codezone to 51% for EGP 31.3 million (USD 603,270) in Q1 2025, per TechCabal; the financier is Egyptian.
Fawry says it invested EGP 565.6 million (USD 10.9 million) in new PoS devices in 2025, its own spending in Egypt, per TechCabal.

In May 2025 Fawry signed a securitisation transfer agreement with Egypt's Capital for Securitisation Company for a first issuance of its microloans valued at EGP 497.5 million (USD 9.6 million), sold to institutional investors, per TechCabal.

facts.fact: Fawry raised EGP 497.5 million (USD 9.6 million) in Egypt in May 2025 by securitising microloans through Capital for Securitisation Company, the first part of a planned EGP 8 billion three-year programme, per TechCabal.
